reviews.name: Hoang Pham Family
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Eddies from Sunrise Group LLC. On Sunday, November 1st, my home experienced a roof leak, even though the house is only about five years old. Eddies came out that same day and thoroughly inspected everything in a very professional manner. He also provided me with a clear estimate right away. I truly appreciate his prompt response, professionalism, and honesty. Although I haven’t decided on the next steps yet, I am very impressed with his work and highly recommend Edith and Sunrise Group LLC!

reviews.name: James Jones
reviews.text: We hired Sunrise Roofers at the recommendation of another contractor we had used in Oro Valley. From the first inquiry, Eddie, the owner, was professional, responsive and very personable. He followed through on a timely estimate, scheduling around our needs, and completed the work as promised. His team did an excellent job on replacing the roof underlayment, tiles, and skylights. We received photos and a video of the roof before and after the work was completed. He was also flexible and accomodating when we had a slight change in the project. Eddie was wonderful to work with and we would highly recommend him and his company.

reviews.name: Jason Galvez
reviews.text: Eddie did a great job on my project. My wife and I didn't expect are home built 4 years ago to lose tiles but the recent wind we experienced in Marana had other plans. He came the day of the incident on short notice and provided a detailed explanation of what he was going to do. Not only did he replace the 6 tiles that fell, but also re-secured the whole row of 26 tiles with longer nails the builder didn't use. Highly recommend if you want someone reliable with good communication, efficient and quality work.

reviews.name: Cristina Navarro
reviews.text: Eddie helped me at a difficult time with roof damage and flooding in one of my bedrooms. To start off with, his customer service was great from start to finish. I was shown pictures before and after and I am truly amazed at the work he did on my entire roof. Beautiful roof work was completed and I appreciate that he covered my roof due to more rains to hold me over until work could be done. I am forever grateful to him and highly recommend his roofing company! It’s hard to find trustworthy people and I give him as a recommendation for your roofing needs! I appreciate his compassion in a very difficult time in my life as this crisis happened in my home.

reviews.name: Bill Jarvis
reviews.text: This is a great company. I had a roof leak and needed a quick response for a repair. Eddie was very easy to work with. He knows his business and when he examined the roof I was shown pictures of the damage and wear on the roof. The price estimates were accurate and very fair for the amount of work that was done. We had the entire roof done. Very satisfied with the work. Again he has a great team that know what they are doing. Always letting you know if they found other problems along the way and taking pictures of what was wrong. Highly recommend Sunrise Roofers for any and all roofing problems/jobs.

reviews.name: Sue G
reviews.text: A couple of my neighbors used Sunrise Roofers and were very satisfied so I enlisted Sunrise to replace my 20 year old roof. Eddie, the owner, has been in roofing his whole life and is extremely knowledgeable. Eddie's crew has been with him for years and did a fabulous job replacing my roof (1,822 sq. ft home). The crew arrived early and worked through each day with a short lunch break. They really know roofs and materials and I couldn't be more pleased that I went with Sunrise Roofers.

reviews.name: Rob Friedberg
reviews.text: Great experience with Eddie!

reviews.name: Brittany Rychetsky
reviews.text: We recently had a roof leak repaired with Sunrise Roofers LLC and could not be more pleased with the quality of work and our overall experience! What would usually be a stressful process was made painless and addressed quickly. Eddie was so professional and communicative every step of the way. He came out quickly to do an estimate and it was competitively priced. He provided a video as part of the inspection so we could see exactly what was happening on the roof and why he was making the recommendations made for repair. He even took the time to educate us on the cause of the leak and how to prevent it in the future. We were also provided with progress pictures as the work was being completed. His team was pleasant and they cleaned up as they worked. Eddie found roof tiles that match so well you can’t even tell we had them replaced in that section. It’s so wonderful to be able to enjoy the rain now without worrying about the roof! We highly recommend Sunrise Roofers LLC and will continue to work with them as needed in the future!!

reviews.name: Joanne Stephens
reviews.text: Sunrise Roofers LLC reroofed my home last week. They were amazing both in customer service and completing the work in a timely manner. I had a leak and they fixed it before the next storm was able to do more damage. My roof was 20 years old and I was unaware that the underlayment had been compromised. The owner Eddie Guillen was extremely easy to work with. He was very professional. His crew were also very good at their jobs. He even arranged to have my solar panels removed and replaced so they could complete the work.

reviews.name: David Gin
reviews.text: Eddie and his crew did an excellent job we are very satisfied with our new roof and would recommend them to anyone interested in installing a new roof.They were very efficient an focused on doing a great job--- they worked very hard and were very courteous and cleaned up everyday and Eddie (owner) gave us an excellent price!.They were very efficient too.

reviews.name: Charmaine Wright
reviews.text: Wonderful experience and highly recommended. Eddie explained in detail work needed to be done and videos explaining damage that occurred. Professional and honest. Feel so relaxed roof was repaired with integrity and honesty!!

reviews.name: Dan Campbell
reviews.text: Exceptional!! From all the estimates we got only Eddie took the time to go over all aspects of a roof replacement. Eddie also mentioned how good his crew was and he underestimated how much effort they expended in getting our roof perfect and leaving a clean job site everyday! We highly recommend Sunrise Roofers!

reviews.name: keegan thomas
reviews.text: I was having issues with a roof from another contractor, and I had Eddie come out and give a thorough inspection. Eddie did an excellent job, pointing out the deficiencies that needed to be addressed. He provided a detailed report and video of his inspection. I would definitely recommend Eddie and Sunrise Roofing!

reviews.name: Mark Robinson
reviews.text: Fantastic service and quality. Very professional. I would highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Rowdy Wright
reviews.text: We needed a new roof done on our home. After speaking with Eddie from sunrise roofers, I was happy to them do the work. They were very professional, courteous and extremely hard working. They did an outstanding job. Sunrise roofers takes pride in their work and it shows. I highly recommend them if you're needing a new roof or repairs. Thank you!

reviews.name: Tony Everett
reviews.text: While only a relatively small job, Eddie and Adolfo provided timely and quality service to, and through completion. All my expectations were not only met, they were exceeded. I can and would recommend Sunrise without reservationl

reviews.name: Doyle Petersen
reviews.text: I watched Sunrise Roofers redo a roof in our neighborhood and was impressed with the final job, so I asked them for a quote on re-roofing our house. They were not the lowest bid: neither were they the highest. I was impressed with Eddie, the owner of the company and his descriptions of how they would do the work and the materials they would use. I hired them and it was a great decision. Eddie provided photos of the work as it progressed with a video when the job was completed. The roof was completed on time and the site was completely cleaned before they left. My wife and I are very happy with the finished job and recommend Eddie and his crew.

reviews.name: Sam De Caro
reviews.text: EDDIE did a great job with the wind damage from a micro bust and inspected the whole roof. Would definitely use again.

reviews.name: Pastores Cabrera
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) Excellent service and good communication… (Original) Excelente servicio y buena comunicación…

reviews.name: Wesley Hudson
reviews.text: Saved us in a pinch! Eddie is awesome and would recommend anyone looking for roofing services to contact sunrise

reviews.name: Denon Hildreth
reviews.text: Eddie did a complete roof inspection and provided me with a very complete and detailed report and estimate for my aged roof. I appreciate his relaxed no pressure approach, and providing information and video on the condition of my roof, options to repair it. He even shared a small portion of his roof mastic for a quick spot repair. All this was provided for free, I very much recommend them. Thanks Eddie

reviews.name: M K
reviews.text: About a week ago I had a roof tile crash to the ground about five feet from where I was having coffee on our back patio. It really shook me up, especially because I have a dog and kids, so I needed someone to come out that day. Eddie was booked for that day, but I think when he heard how desperate I was he squeezed me in and for that I am so grateful. That’s a personal touch that you just don’t get from a lot of places. When he arrived he went up on the roof, removed another tile that was about to come off, and then did an inspection to see what was wrong. He found a few things and we scheduled full repairs for the next week. Communication was always good and he showed us plenty of photos to help explain the different things that were going on. When the work was done, we were very pleased with the results as well as the thorough cleanup job. From start to finish, both my husband and I were really pleased and would recommend Eddie and his crew to anybody.

reviews.name: Denise Lewis
reviews.text: Don't go with anyone else. Not only was he professional, prompt and affordable, but he provided some great options for our roof issue.

reviews.name: Shannon Ruedlinger
reviews.text: Eddie and his crew replaced the roof on my 65+ year old home in Skyline. It was a complete tear off. They did a fantastic job navigating all of the nuances of an older home, sloping the roof to drain properly, cleaned up the job site every day and checked in with me every day while on the job. If my next home requires roof repair/replacement, I will only use Sunrise Roofers.

reviews.name: Julie McIntyre
reviews.text: Eddie and his crew were responsive, kind, and prompt. Eddie took time to come to my home on the edge of town and communicate about all the options. My second story pitch is steep with older tiles, and he and his crew were safety conscious and careful and they cleaned up the work site perfectly. Their knowledge and skill are reflected in the final outcome of my roof repair and I am very pleased! I am going to work with them again to repair a patio roof leak! I recommend them to anyone with roof issues, repairs, or full replacements. Thank you, Eddie, Roger, and crew!

reviews.name: Gabriela Valencia
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) Why I highly recommend Sunrise Roofers LLC...!! After searching for three options where the cost was beyond my budget, a friend recommended Sunrise Roofers. I must admit I contacted them with some trepidation. From the very first moment, the owner, Eddie Guillén and his team, who personally assisted me, instilled complete confidence. I received the best quote I could have ever imagined, nearly $5,000 cheaper than the other companies. He inspired so much confidence that I did not hesitate to sign the contract, and I received an excellent/super-excellent result on the roof of my property and on other extras I provided as a courtesy, specifically the roof of the back porch. reviews.name: Ale C
reviews.text: They did great work repairing some damage to the roof of a home I was selling. The pricing was very reasonable and they were able to fit in on a bit of a time crunch, it’s very obvious from the before and after of the roof. Their team takes the time to tidy up and pay close attention to detail to make sure the roof is exactly where it should be before they leave. Area also looked clean which is a nice change of pace since a lot of contractors/repairmen in Tucson aren’t the best with the cleanup after. Color matching of tiles was almost exact too which is a great bonus!

reviews.name: Michael Middleton
reviews.text: Sunrise Roofers were very professional and hard working. They wasted no time getting the job done. They also took care of all the little things that made their work five stars plus.

reviews.name: Rachel Brock
reviews.text: Eddie and his team did an excellent job on my roof repair/replacement. He is extremely knowledgeable about roofing and provided detailed information for each step in the process. He even replaced one of my baseboards that had been damaged by a previous roof leak. I highly recommend Sunrise Roofers!

reviews.name: Sheryl Cain
reviews.text: From start to finish, Sunrise Roofers gave a solid performance. The owner, Eddie Guillen, gave our tile roof a thorough inspection, detailed estimate with pictures, and promptly replied to any questions or concerns. Eddie and his crew (same men every day) were prompt, worked efficiently, were respectful of our property, kept things clean and tidy on a daily basis, and were friendly and polite. They are an impressive team. The materials used are of the highest quality, chosen to best endure our desert climate and monsoon season. They replaced the skylight in our golf cart garage with a superior model at no extra charge. They did an impeccable job on the finish work for the flashing, fascia, and bird stop. I could not be happier or more grateful to Sunrise Roofers for the amazing job they did. They deserve far more than five stars, and I give them my highest recommendation. Thank you Eddie and Sunrise Roofers! You guys rock!

reviews.name: Glenda Wood
reviews.text: I had the best experience when Eddie roofed my house after a huge hailstorm destroyed it along with the skylights. He worked with my insurance company to get them to cover everything. When I discovered a leak he came to my house and determined the air conditioning unit was not installed properly by the company I bought it from. He did a few soak tests and then fixed the leak himself so I didn't have to contact the AC company and convince them that the problem was theirs to fix. He definitely goes the extra mile. Quality person and service!

reviews.name: Jerry James
reviews.text: I was very happy with the work performed, they were very reliable,friendly and answered any questions that I had.I would recommend them very highly to anyone.I am a very satisfied customer.

reviews.name: Sarah Wilson
reviews.text: Edie did an excellent job repairing the various problems on my roof. He was very professional, prompt, responsive to my questions, gave clear explainations (and photos) about the issues and the work he would do to correct them, the job was reasonably priced, and Edie was very friendly and personable. I will recommend him to friends and neighbors.

reviews.name: Maryfaith Marshall
reviews.text: Eddie Guillen and all of the people with whom he works are outstanding: one thousand percent competent, and skilled, kind, generous, so clearly honest that I could just take a deep breath and trust whatever Eddie told me. Eddie and his crew are resilient and flexible. Establishing a rapport with him so that you can easily communicate and stay on the same page is easy with Eddie. We cannot recommend Eddie and his crew highly enough. They did a meticulous job on replacing our roof and it is beautiful. We are confident that it will last a good long time. Throughout the process, Eddie stands behind his work. He is readily available to explain and answer your questions and help you in any way he can. We feel so very fortunate that he and his crew have completed all of this beautiful work on our home. And he is very reasonably priced.

reviews.name: Debbie Foster
reviews.text: Dependable, professional, and great customer service. Thank you

reviews.name: kaydinheart
reviews.text: Great work! Totally satisfied with all aspects of a job well done!

reviews.name: Paul Wichmann
reviews.text: Good work and responsive to concerns that arise.

reviews.name: Brittany Palma
reviews.text: They did an amazing job! Definitely sending their number out.

reviews.name: Sarah Hall
reviews.text: Sunrise Roofers are amazing! They did our inspection for our new house and they were able to get out there and give us their assessment quickly, We also heard from the superintendent they were some of the most professional roofers he had ever interacted with. Highly recommend and appreciate their work!

reviews.name: Anka Hui
reviews.text: For the past few jobs with them, Eddie was professional, responsive, and truly cared about doing the job right. They showed up on time, communicated clearly every step of the way, and provided itemised quotes with details. If you’re looking for a reliable, honest, and skilled roofing company in Tucson, I highly recommend Sunrise Roofing. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.name: GG Rand
reviews.text: Eddie, from Sunrise Roofers came out to my house and did an extremely thorough roof inspection. He also removed a cactus growing on my roof. Very professional and nice, treated me with respect also.

reviews.name: hty
reviews.text: Sunrise Roofers just finished replacing my tile roof. I am very happy that I used them because they did a nice job, we’re very professional and they beat everyone else’s price. Eddie is very nice and easy to work with. He came out to my house immediately when I called. They also finish very fast. I would 100% recommend to use this company.

reviews.name: Michael Boggie
reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience with a thorough, knowledgeable, professional and qualified contractor. Eddie, of Sunrise Roofers, LLC, exceeded my expectations, installed one of the highest quality products on the market and completed the installation with the detail characteristics of a company that practices honesty, care and customer service. His service was at a competitive price, providing me with options that enhanced the outcome, details that cure possible deficiencies and a superior product that looks great and will provide long-term protection and peace of mind.

reviews.name: Eric Bigelow
reviews.text: We were really lucky we found Sunrise Roofers. This was my first time needing roofing service for a house and I used everything from AI to internet searches to get a good understanding for costs and timeframes. My insurance took a while longer than I thought but the roofers were patient and took detailed pictures along with great descriptions that really helped with insurance.

reviews.name: Alexis Fahlman
reviews.text: They were very responsive and quick to help me get an estimate on my clients roof! Provided a very detailed inspection with photos and videos explaining what work needs to be done! On top of being knowledgeable and diligent, he also was willing to work on the aluminum which is super helpful because I’ve been turned down by multiple other contractors!

reviews.name: mario lizarraga
reviews.text: Nice job guys tankyou so much

reviews.name: Hudson Musgrove
reviews.text: Eddie an his team did a great job with repairing a drainage issue with our flat roof. He also did a full re-coat on our roof as well. He was fair priced, honest and detailed.

reviews.name: george nyawo
reviews.text: I had such a great experience with Eddie and his team. Their work ethic and attention to detail are amazing. They did a very professional roof installation quality-wise and on time. I will not hesitate to refer anyone to Sunrise Roofers.

reviews.name: Stu
reviews.text: Inspection was thorough. Work required was presented in a very detailed but understandable fashion. Work was accomplished on schedule and within timelines described. I was VERY impressed with follow up by the company. They were a delight to work with

reviews.name: Rosa Moreno
reviews.text: One of the best people I've ever worked with. As women we always care about what we wear and what we eat. But I learn so much with the detail in materials and everything that goes on top of your roof it's amazing how Eddie explain. to me about materials and these and that. Very important details that other companies fail to explain about the difference of putting something cheap and something that is gonna last longer. He well knows what he does compare to others. (Don't use cheap)!!!! Learn more about it first!!!!!! Who knows what they put on your roof without telling you, giving you chip materials and later on.You find out in a bad way It happens!!! If you appreciate HONESTY he is the guy!!

reviews.name: Olga Guillen
reviews.text: Excellent work went above and beyond ! Great customer service!

reviews.name: Javier Guillen
reviews.text: Honest reliable and friendly!!

reviews.name: KJ
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! Awesome company, owner is very well educated, and intelligent on his trade, and extremely ambitious. Thoughtful enough to come on their days off to prevent natural damage like storms and rain. Hardworking and honest business, will not disappoint you in the work they do! If your thinking about having work done or really need it you need to look no more, your worries will be satisfied, get in contact for a quote as soon as you can! 🙌🏽

reviews.name: Robert Flores
reviews.text: EDDIE AT SUNRISE ROOFERS IS A GREAT PERSON TO WORK WITH. HELP YOU WITH ALL NEED. THEY ARE GREAT AT WORK AND CLEAN UP AFTERTHEY ARE DONE. I WOULD RACOMMEN THEM IF YOU NEED ROOF WORK. THAT'S SUNRISE ROOFERS.

reviews.name: Jeny Fox
reviews.text: Eddie was awesome to work with. This roofer went the extra mile from start to finish. He was professional, kind and always on time. I would give this roofers 10 stars if I could. It was a joy to work with him! He was very detail oriented and the roof is beautiful! Thank you Eddie for being so honest and trustworthy!

reviews.name: Ernesto Ortega
reviews.text: Eddie Guillen from Sunrise Roofers LLC did an outstanding job on my full roof replacement. He was professional, efficient, and paid close attention to every detail. The quality of work was excellent, and he also gave me great preventative maintenance tips to help extend the life of my new roof. Highly recommend Eddie and his team for anyone needing reliable, high-quality roofing services!
